name: Registration
ask: Show the registry entry or protocol: what was planned, and when it was registered.

name: Prespecified aims
ask: State the objectives or hypotheses as they were set before the data came in.

name: Randomisation
ask: How was the allocation sequence made, and who could see it before each assignment?

name: Intervention details
ask: Describe the intervention and the comparator well enough for someone to repeat them.

name: Setting and dates
ask: When and where were exposures, outcomes and follow-up measured?

name: Search strategy
ask: List every source you searched and give the full search strings.

name: Reflexivity
ask: Who collected the data, and what was their relationship with the participants?

name: Reference standard
ask: Which test decided who truly had the condition, and did everyone get it?

name: Recruitment
ask: Who was eligible, and how were participants found and selected?

name: Flow diagram
ask: How many were eligible, included, lost and analysed, and why was anyone lost?

name: Sample size
ask: How was the number of participants decided?

name: Data saturation
ask: When did you stop collecting data, and how did you judge it was enough?

name: Blinding
ask: Who knew the groups, or the other test results, when the outcomes were assessed?

name: Measures
ask: How exactly was each outcome and exposure measured, and is the measure valid?

name: Coding tree
ask: How many people coded the data, and what does the coding tree look like?

name: Risk-of-bias assessment
ask: How was the risk of bias in each included study judged, and by whom?

name: Missing data
ask: How much data was missing, and how was it handled?

name: Sensitivity analysis
ask: Do the results hold under other reasonable analysis choices?

name: Confounder adjustment
ask: Which confounders were adjusted for, and why those?

name: Analysis set
ask: Who or what was counted in each analysis, and in which group?

name: Theme derivation
ask: Were the themes set in advance, or derived from the data?

name: Test cut-offs
ask: Was the cut-off for a positive test fixed before the data, or chosen after?

name: Heterogeneity
ask: How much did the studies' results differ, and was that explored?

name: Reporting bias
ask: Could missing studies or missing results have biased the pooled estimate?
